newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs seen up cautiously, scam woes ease.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs seen up cautiously, scam woes ease.

text.p: Brazil stocks are seen rising cautiously Friday on eased concerns over an alleged cash-for-votes scandal.
Traders said local newspapers today did not bring any fresh corruption allegations that could worry investors.
Brazil's stock market has been rattled by a series of reports by Folha de Sao Paulo daily alleging a vote-buying scheme to get a re-election bill approved by deputies.
Communications Minister Sergio Motta has strongly denied allegations of wrongdoing.

The scandal erupted Tuesday when Folha published a transcript of what it said was a taped conversation in which a congressman claimed he and four other deputies had received money in exchange for voting for the bill allowing presidential re-election.
Analysts said the market could remain volatile if speculation about fresh corruption allegations continues.
Vale do Rio Doce flat at 23.90 reais
